# sra_security_provider (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one Security Provider by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sra_security_provider" "supplier" {
  name = "Supplier"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The exact, case-insensitive name of the Security Provider.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Security Provider is enabled.
- `group_lookup` (Boolean) Whether the Security Provider looks up user groups.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier assigned to the Security Provider.
- `type` (String) The type of the Security Provider.
- `user_authentication` (Boolean) Whether the Security Provider authenticates users.
